task: Rotate the mTLS certificates for the service mesh before they expire in 48 h. Candidate pool from a 170-entry store across infra, security, and app projects.

candidate_memories.content: Certificate expiry alert fired: mesh root CA and all leaf certs expire in 47 h; rotation must complete before then.
mTLS cert rotation uses cert-manager CertificateRequest; trigger via kubectl annotate certificate mesh-root rotate=true.
After root CA rotation, all sidecar proxies must be restarted to pick up the new CA bundle; rolling restart order: infra → app → edge.
Istio version was upgraded to 1.21 last week; all proxies are healthy post-upgrade.
TLS 1.2 is disabled across the mesh; only TLS 1.3 is permitted per security policy.
The external API gateway uses a separate Let's Encrypt cert managed by ingress-nginx; not part of the mesh rotation.
Old cert rotation runbook from 2023 used cfssl manually; that process was replaced by cert-manager in 2024.
candidate_memories.notes: stale: manual cfssl process replaced by cert-manager

candidate_memories.content: Security team audited mesh config yesterday; no policy violations found.
Cert expiry alerts must fire at 72 h and 24 h before expiry; paging at 24 h.
service-to-service auth uses SPIFFE identities encoded in the SAN field of each leaf cert.
DB certs are managed separately by the DBA team; they confirmed no DB cert rotation is needed this week.
